text: OVERDOSAGE Overdosage of nitroprusside can be manifested as excessive hypotension or cyanide toxicity (see WARNINGS ) or as thiocyanate toxicity (see ADVERSE REACTIONS ). The acute intravenous mean lethal doses (LD 50 ) of nitroprusside in rabbits, dogs, mice, and rats are 2.8, 5, 8.4, and 11.2 mg/kg, respectively.
